choice: DisputedOnlyOnADifference first broke on an 11-step path: Labeled, a differing ruling, Disputed, then Torian writes a new ruling that the runner has not read yet
why: the rule was too strong, not the design: between runs a new ruling can sit unread; the fix to the rule (differs, or a new ruling is waiting) also fixed the design: Disputed -> Settled fires on any change to the ruling file, whatever its value, because Torian's ruling is golden
evidence: report.md of the first run; rule restated and rechecked on both configs

choice: a label rejected for a missing term never rests in Rejected: the runner routes it in the same run, so a model retry cannot reach it until the owning scope defines the term
why: the chart with only the missing-term failure drew no Rejected -> Proposed arrow; it appears once a non-missing failure kind is in the model
evidence: chart config without badTerm: 16 arrows, retry missing; with badTerm: 17 arrows. Kept as Appendix E says; an open call for Torian

why: S3-PR2 made a ruling settle one field of one idea, so a label and a ruling compare as equal values with no translation; terms are the nouns the label rests on, the only way a proposal can name a term the catalog can route (model-the-domain, type-system-discipline)

why: one table replaces the scattered state checks; the test compares the table with the design doc so the two cannot drift (model-the-domain)
evidence: reconcile-ideas-test asserts the table equals Appendix E

choice: SchemaCheck reads the noun pattern of the ontology metamodel's change line; TermCheck runs the EE-095 term typed-link over every idea with the label applied and the catalog-test owning-scope rule for terms; ProofCheck runs disagreements() and readLean() from schema/terms/lean-agreement-test.ts

why: spawning python per line would cost a process per proposal; parity is checked rather than assumed

choice: docs/reviews/ontology-program/reconcile/state.jsonl and queue.jsonl, JSON Lines, written through a rename and only when the content changes; an empty state that does not exist stays absent

evidence: reconcile-ideas-test rerun case; mutation that drops the no-change write fails the test
